title: Make Rust review gate resolve Cargo under Windows WSL Bash
outcome: The required parent review gate scripts/test-rust.sh failed before tests on 2026-08-26 because PowerShell resolves bash to C:\Windows\System32\bash.exe (WSL), whose PATH does not include the Windows Cargo installation at C:\Users\grzeg\.cargo\bin. Evidence: cargo check succeeds natively; the wrapper prints its FD/thread settings then exits at line 60 with exec: cargo: not found. Diagnose and make the documented cross-platform invocation resolve Cargo reliably without weakening the FD/test-thread bounds. Immediate review next action: invoke the unchanged wrapper through WSL with the Cargo path explicitly bridged, and require the original wrapper test command to pass before spawning reviewers.
disposal_reason: Backlog triage w-930e4d333f07 (Architect1 batch 2 re-check, spot-checked by Termal::Fable2): CLOSE-DONE. The gate runs scripts/test-rust.sh through Git for Windows bash by an explicit path (scripts/test-launcher.mjs:150-159, windowsGitBash), never the WSL bash this item is about.
